posts.description: Have you ever stopped to think about just how many receipts you’ve gotten over the years? posts.description: Everyone thinks that revenge will solve all of their problems. I hear about it from my patients all the time. They sit on my little couch, and list off the names of all the people they would kill in cold blood if they got a chance. I tell them that’s probably not a great idea, but it’s a free country.
